_comment: Pinned SGLang revision for HeteroSpec experiments. Every serious run records this commit. Upstream moves ~every 30 min; we re-sync deliberately between GPU sessions, never during one.
base_commit_subject: [HiCache] ci: add HiCache and unified radix rerun group (#40831)

relevant_upstream_prs.27493: init adaptive spec params from config (merged)
relevant_upstream_prs.37274: allow custom policy for adaptive speculative decoding (merged) -- our extension point
relevant_upstream_prs.28045: cost-aware policy (NOT MERGED -- do not call this the SGLang baseline)

notes: Only 1 of the 33 commits between the original fork HEAD (720617bb5) and this base touched python/sglang/srt/speculative/ (deprecated env-var removal in spec_info.py/spec_registry.py), so the Phase 1 audit remains valid at this commit.
adaptive_unsupported_reason() permits adaptive mode only for EAGLE/EAGLE3 with speculative_eagle_topk=1, no DP attention, no multi-layer EAGLE, no two-batch overlap, no pdmux.
